invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of the commitStats call, so result equals its value.
instantTime is likely required for the commit operation to proceed and is dereferenced in the next call.
writeStatuses is dereferenced to build writeStats, so it cannot be null.
commitActionType is passed through and likely required by commitStats.
partitionToReplacedFileIds is dereferenced by commitStats, so it is expected to be non-null.
